notes: Use an explicit Speech resource baseUrl such as https://RESOURCE.cognitiveservices.azure.com and enable media.http.enabled. This is not /mai/v1/audio/transcriptions.

Standard audio/transcriptions maps file to audio, language to locales and model to definition.enhancedMode. Only synchronous json/text results are mapped; no translation, fabricated timing, transcoding or file splitting.

Native /v1/providers/azure-speech/{publicModel}/transcriptions accepts audio and a JSON definition with enhancedMode.enabled=true and enhancedMode.model=MAI-Transcribe-2. It preserves native diarization, timestamps and extension fields/results.

Microsoft's Speech table publishes an early-bird USD 0.10 per audio hour through 2026-12-31. The release capsule and linked model page record a standard USD 0.36 per audio hour; the current card keeps the promotional rate and must be reviewed when the offer ends. perSecond is the exact converted promotional rate, and billingIncrementSeconds=1 rounds each request's billed duration up to a whole second without changing reported duration.
Maximum accepted file is WAV/MP3/FLAC, 300 MB or two hours. This is an endpoint media limit, not a model token context window.

modelVersion remains unverified: the capsule's 2026-09-03 value is the public-preview release date, not a deployment revision. Native provider requests use Speech transcription, not /mai/v1/audio/transcriptions; the public proxy route is an adapter.
